issues.detail: Contract lets prev_in update during reset cycles and captures immediately after reset using a reset-cycle input; spec does not define reset-boundary previous-input history and this is not marked uncertain.
issues.spec_evidence: changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next
issues.alternative: Reset clears or ignores previous input history, so the first cycle after reset cannot capture a 1-to-0 transition from the reset cycle; out remains 0.
